scripts.dev:mobile: cd apps/mobile && APP_VARIANT=development npx expo start --dev-client --lan
scripts.dev:mobile:tunnel: cd apps/mobile && APP_VARIANT=development npx expo start --dev-client --tunnel
scripts.dev:mobile:staging: cd apps/mobile && APP_VARIANT=development API_URL=https://api.staging.mindscope.kr npx expo start --dev-client --tunnel
scripts.build:mobile:ios: cd apps/mobile && eas build --profile development --platform ios
scripts.build:mobile:android: cd apps/mobile && eas build --profile development --platform android
scripts.build:mobile:ios:sim: cd apps/mobile && eas build --profile development-simulator --platform ios
scripts.build:mobile:preview: cd apps/mobile && eas build --profile preview --platform ios
scripts.submit:mobile:preview: cd apps/mobile && eas submit --profile preview --platform ios --latest
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && trap 'kill 0' EXIT; uv run python -m app.worker.stream & uv run python -m app.worker.batch & uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3502 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 1
scripts.dev:api:worker: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.worker.event
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
